# SlimeTinker Legacy 2.0.4

Dependency-cleanup release for Slimefun Legacy servers.

## GuizhanLib no longer required

- Removes the startup check that disabled SlimeTinker when `GuizhanLibPlugin` was absent.
- Removes the GuizhanLib updater integration and its Maven dependency.
- Removes `GuizhanLibPlugin` from `plugin.yml` soft dependencies.
- Removes the obsolete `auto-update` setting tied to GuizhanLib.
- Keeps Slimefun as the only hard plugin dependency; existing addon compatibility soft-dependencies remain unchanged.

No SlimeTinker tools, materials, modifiers, leveling, IE2 integration, or player data behavior is intentionally changed by this release.
